text: サイクリング　ロードは　うみを　いく　さかみち！

structure.jp: サイクリング　ロードは
うみを　いく　さかみち！
structure.en: a slope that runs over the sea!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: うみを　いく　さかみち
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing tells you which thing it is. うみを　いく　さかみち = 'a slope that goes over the sea'.

patterns.name: 〜を (path)
patterns.explanation: を with a verb of moving shows the place you move through or across. うみを　いく = 'go across the sea'.
